description: List scheduled meetings (events). Requires a user URI OR an organization URI (get them from current_user). Filter by status, time window, and paginate. Returns event URIs/UUIDs, names, start/end times, status, and locations.

_apiKey.description: Calendly personal access token (sent as Bearer token)

count.description: Number of results per page (default 20, max 100).

max_start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only events starting at/before this time.

min_start_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only events starting at/after this time.

organization.description: Organization URI (from current_user). Provide user OR organization.

page_token.description: Token from a previous response for the next page.

user.description: User URI (from current_user). Provide user OR organization.

name: list_scheduled_events
